batting.name: MW Short
batting.dismissal: c PP Chawla b C Green

batting.name: LS Livingstone
batting.dismissal: st Ishan Kishan b PP Chawla

batting.name: Ishan Kishan
batting.dismissal: c MW Short b Arshdeep Singh

batting.name: C Green
batting.dismissal: c SM Curran b NT Ellis

batting.name: SA Yadav
batting.dismissal: c Atharva Taide b Arshdeep Singh

balls.text: Brar runs back, pushes for two. Throw comes in, Kishan takes off the bails. Sent upstairs. Replays show he was just short. It was a full ball outside off at 130kph that was heaved to midwicket
Brar almost makes too much room and has to reach out, back foot slipped but he somehow slapped it through cover. In the gap, along the ground. Four
Jitesh misses, Jason hits middle stump and is pumped but the 7-ball 25 cameo has taken Kings over 200. Was a length ball angling in, Jitesh made room and heaved across, missed it.
Bouncer just under chest-height is pulled and it's into the stratosphere. Way over backward square for a monster. Jitesh wants to check for a no-ball but that bouncer was not high
Beaten on the pull, the bouncer angles past Jitesh's shoulders. He had gone across and that worked against him
Kings' 200 is up. Full toss just outside off, Jitesh held his shape and slashed. Got it over mid-off for a 104-metre six

Archer's raw pace is back, Curran's fending, ball takes the leading edge and Archer takes a return catch. Curran was making room but the shortish ball came crashing into his chest, he took his front hand off and the ball hit the sticker and popped up, Archer took the catch on the move. End of a brilliant 55 from Curran

Scythed skillfully to the left of backward point. Was a low full toss at the stumps, Archer tried to follow him again but Curran managed to make just enough room to go through with the drive. Raced along the ground
Makes room again, Archer follows him with a back of length ball. Curran tries to chop it but misses
Fifty for Curran, he scythes a full toss outside off in front of point to get there. Raises his bat Flintoff style and pumps his fist.
Around yorker length just outside off at 143kph, whipped to deep midwicket along the ground
Makes room and slaps the full ball to long-off
This one's slot on off, Jitesh winds up and drives, he pilots a drive in fact. Nails it over long-off
Jitesh needs no sighters, he belts his first ball over long-off for a 74-metre six. Length outside off, he used the room to whack it away

Yorker knocks over Harpreet . Underedge as he tries to guide it fine, both bails fly and he can't get to fifty. Harpreet was making room and Green stuck to the yorker, got it just outside off, the angle off the bat brought it back onto the stumps to end a 92-run stand.
Curran makes room and is followed by a back-of-length 138kph ball this time. Clipped to long-on
Pumped down the ground. 84 off the last 30 balls, says Matthew Hayden on air. Curran was making room and got followed by a slot ball, he hit it at the sight screen for an 84-metre six
Curran's helping the cause, belts this over cover. Length outside off at 125kph, smacked it over wide mid-off and there's a crowd catch
Yorker on off at 147kph, driven back to the bowler
Curran makes room and gets a yorker on middle, goes for the drive through cover. Gets an inside edge onto square leg
Yorker on off at 143kph. Harpreet got his feet out the way and jammed his bat into the turf, dust flew as he got an outside edge. Goes to deep third
Pulled behind square for six more. Harpreet used Archer's angle, whacked it off a back of length for a 64-metre six
Around the block hole, it beats the flick and hits the pad. Deflects to the off side and they run a single

High full toss from Archer, Curran goes for the cover drive. Goes off the edge in the gap between keeper and short third. Not called a no-ball. Curran reviews. He's in the crease and on his tiptoes, the hawk-eye shows the line zipping around the elastic on the trouser. Close call and the third umpire calls it fair

Pulled fine, short fine leg leaps across but can't stop the ball. Four more. It was a slower bouncer down leg, Harpreet tried to pull from down to up and go fine. Went off the bottom of the bat, flew in the air, bounced high off the grass and beat the fielder. Sachin doesn't look pleased
Beamer. Bhatia was swivelling as he tried to pull, went off the glove and went to the short-third boundary. Arjun put his hand up in apology early. It was around chest-height and went fine
Full toss. Looks like the yorker gone wrong, Harpreet crouched a bit and pulled it over backward square for a flat six
Too full, Bhatia launches it with a drive. Doesn't middle it but mid-off was in, David can't run back and take it as it landed not too far from the ropes. Fifty stand is up
Full and wide, driven to deep point

Edge flies to the deep-third boundary. Was full outside off, Curran tried to slash it over cover, ball went over Jofra at short third and went over the cushion. Arjun closes his eyes and turns in frustration as he completes his run up
Slightly wider of the crease, the wide yorker is just past the off-side tramline. Let go, Arjun asks his skipper by signalling for the review but there won't be one.
Slot ball is smacked down the ground. The 124kph ball was outside off and Curran swiped across, ball sailed over straight long-off for an 83-metre six
Bhatia goes for the slog sweep and misses. He planted his front foot in front and tried to launch it across/behind square. The flat, length ball deflected off the pad towards point
Slightly short just outside off at 91kph. Pulled to long-on. It's a no-ball! The toe is just over the line during the first point of contact.

Another push for two, Curran puts in a full-length dive and makes it. Was a length ball at the stumps, punched to the left of long-on. Curran did ball-watch a bit but managed to keep the speed up and committed to the dive.
Sits up and Curran launches a pull over midwicket. It was slow on a length, Curran rocked back and deposited it 75 metres far
Punches a length ball to long-on

Batters push for two and make it. It was a length ball outside off, Bhatia tried to paddle it. Hit the pad but did it hit the glove on the way? Anyway, it deflects towards deep fine leg. Replays show it hit the pad but it might have angled down leg.
Length on middle, flicked to midwicket
Full on leg, flicked to deep square leg
Curran makes room early and his footwork is iffy again but he manages to guide the length ball just outside off to deep third.

Curran makes room and swings, finally connects. Long-on runs to the right but it's too straight. Punjab's 100 is up. It was on a length and Curran swiped across, baseball style, got it into the outfield.
Curran makes room and is followed by a 129kph length ball, driven to cover
Flicks the length ball at 128kph to long-on.
Curran goes across and back in his crease, Green keeps it on a length and follows him. Defended off the back foot to cover.
Reaches out and square drives the full ball outside off, point dives to the left but can't stop it. No chance for deep-backward point and Rohit is unhappy with the ball
Pulled to the deep, the batters push for two. Harpreet puts in the dive as the keeper takes off the bails. Sent upstairs. Replays show he made it in easy
Tries to push towards cover, opens the face a bit too much. The length ball outside off takes the inside edge and rolls towards midwicket
Punches a length ball to long-on
Arm ball on a back of length is slung across. Angles in and is punched back to the bowler
Fullish ball around fourth stump at 94kph, defended in front of point
Back of length outside off, Curran's hopping again as he taps it off the back foot to point
Back of length just outside off, defended off the back foot while jumping back. Ball goes to point
Curran's feet get stuck and is beaten on the cut. Was a length ball close to the off-side tramline, batter slashed and missed.
Length just over the top of middle and off, pulled to deep square
Chops the length ball outside off while trying to cut, goes onto the pitch and back at his body
Back of length just outside off at 134kph, jabbed into the grass with an open bat face. Rolls to point
Length outside off, punched to cover
Length on off, clipped to midwicket

Chipped over cover, deep cover runs to the left and stops it with the dive. Looks like Tilak who's saved two. Long-off came across to complete the relay. Was a full ball outside off. Short run is being checked but Curran managed to pat his bat inside the crease.
Full ball is pushed back to the bowler
Length on off from around, the flat ball is punched to long-off
Full on off, driven to long-off
Defends the length ball on off to the bowler.
Length outside off, guided to short third

Dragged onto the stumps off the elbow. Taide was on one knee and tried to pull the length ball and missed it. It hit pad and lobbed back, onto the bottom part of the elbow and nudged the stumps. Chawla was turning for the lbw appeal but realised he had Taide bowled. Two wickets in the over. Nice innings by Taide too.
Full on leg, clipped to deep forward square
Full ball is pushed back to the bowler

Brilliant stumping from Kishan, a la Dinesh Karthik to Michael Vaughan in 2004. Was a legbreak that was flat. Chawla went quicker as he saw Liam charge. The ball beat the flick and went well to the left of the keeper. Kishan leapt across and dislodged the bails in one motion. He took the ball, his back leg was stretched back, facing fine leg but managed to push his hands, reach out and clip the bails.
Googly comes in to fourth stump, beats the attempted cut
Liam pulls but ends up in a twist, bat turns too as the short ball goes into the grass towards midwicket
Pulled in the air, it goes flat and lands at the end of the circle. Goes to deep square leg. Was a short ball at the body, came around stomach height
Length on off, clipped to the bowler
Wide on a length, slapped to deep cover point
Slower one into the pitch, the batter goes across again and tries to help it across with the pull. Misses
Liam has his saw with a monstrous pull over backward square. Shortish ball outside off, the batter went across and hit it 101 metres far, hit one of the poles on the border of the ground
Liam swipes and misses, Archer has a smile as he stares at the batter. Was a back of length ball outside off that was aimed to mow over midwicket
Length on off, clipped to midwicket
Fifth dot in a row as Liam drives the full ball outside off to cover
Beaten. Googly landed on a fullish length close to the off-side tramline and spun back in. Liam tried to slap it through point and missed it
Down the pitch but the batter is searching a bit. Chawla pulled his length back and hid it outside off, driven circumspectly to cover
Length on middle, the leggie spun away. Clipped to midwicket
Low fully just outside off, Liam goes across and drives back to the bowler
Misses the line, the full ball goes off the flick to the left of fine leg. It's four and Arjun kicks the turf in frustration
Full ball is clipped to midwicket

Yorker hits the boot, given LBW. Prabhsimran reviews. Did it hit bat though? The ball had the seam facing fine leg as it came in, hit the popping crease. The batter was pulling his foot back as he tried to nudge it towards midwicket. It went through the blockhole and into pad. It goes to ball tracking and it shows three reds. Arjun Tendulkar pumps his fists.
Punches a length ball outside off to the right of mid-off. Cover dove but couldn't stop it
Low fully is down leg, beats the flick. Goes to the keeper.
Helped behind square again, this time with a wristy pull. Deep fine leg and deep-backward square run across but Taide has bisected them. The ball was on a back of length on the thigh
Drives off the back foot, doesn't time it perfectly. Gets it to deep cover. Ball was on the shorter side just outside off
Similar ball, this time it's swept in the gap. It goes along the ground a few metres to the right of short fine leg. Deep-backward square runs across but loses the race.
Full on the pads, swept to short fine along the ground
Full just outside off, driven to cover. Pace: 91kph
Inside out over cover to bring up Punjab's fifty. Tossed up and overpitched at the stumps, Prabhsimran made room and slashed it over the infield
Paddles a length ball just down leg past short fine who half-stopped. Stopped at deep fine
Leading edge but played with limited power. So the flick off the full ball at the stumps hovers low and fizzles along the ground towards backward point
Length outside off, driven towards extra cover
Upper cut fine and far! Archer hit a hard length, got it around fifth stump. Taide leant back and helped it away.
Flicked gently off leg stump, takes the length ball to catching midwicket on the bounce
Flicked off the pads, deep square chases to the right and keeps it to two. Was pitched up onto leg at 144kph
Length on leg, clipped to square leg
Full at the stumps, clipped to midwicket
Back of length outside off, runs it away wide of deep third
Length down leg, beats the flick. Wide called
Defends a length ball outside off to cover point
Slower one foxes Prabhsimran who charges, he goes to slap the length ball over cover. Misses
Heaved across, six more behind square! Prabhsimran does well to go across and crouch a bit to catch the length ball around the top of the pads. Gets it just over the ropes for a 59-metre six
Length outside off, crunched to mid-off
Pulled over backward square for a flat six Was a back-of-length ball that was helped across from the waist for a 63-metre six
Length on leg, clipped to the right of mid-on. A but of a late start from the striker but they make it easily.
Pitched up around off, opens the face and drives to deep third
Defends a fullish ball on off to point. Pace: 141kph

Pulled straight to midwicket! Green dug it into the pitch and the ball went around waist-height to Short, who pulled his upper body back and tried to muscle it. Looked like he saw it early but couldn't time the shot. Chawla took a catch in front of his face.
Picked up fine, it's in the gap. Deep-backward square is too straight to come in the frame. Full ball on middle and leg, Short planted his front foot across to off and whipped it away.
Length on off, clipped to deep-forward square
Outside edge goes safely in the vacant slip area. Back of length outside off, Short flashes off the back foot. Aims for cover, goes fine and in the cap
Pushing full but on a length in the channel, pushed with an open-faced angled bat to point.
Full on middle and leg, driven to mid-on

Nails the cover drive, fielder at cover - Rohit - leaps to the right and half-stops it. Mid-off goes back and keeps it to two. Was a full ball outside off that was hit along the ground, with a flourish.

Sweet drive down the ground, past the bowler. Good stop by Green, who slides close to the rope and palms it back in. Third umpire checks if he's made contact with the ball and the cushion simultaneously. Looks like the ball's out before he got to the ropes. Two it is.
Flicks a full ball towards fine leg
Yorker around fifth, dug out to cover
Pitched up outside off, Short connects with a slashy drive. Goes along the ground to the left of mid-off, stopped with a slide.
Wide down leg. Swing in works against Arjun. The fullish ball beats the flick and goes to the keeper
Almost shaves off stump! Curves in off a length, Short looked for the drive through mid-off and left a gate between bat and pad, which the ball snuck through
Driven to the right of mid-off for a quick single. Overpitched by Arjun, who's looking for swing. Came in a bit, Taide lunged on it.
Strays down leg. The fullish ball goes with the swing, past the flick, to the keeper.
Flicked with the inswing to mid-on. Was pitched up at 134kph on middle.
Comes back in a bit off a length. Short chops it from fourth stump towards cover with limited timing
Finishes with a full toss at 138kph. It's at thigh-height and Archer looks to whack it away. Gets it to long-off
Another yorker beats bat but this 137kph ball is outside off. Arshdeep has his hands over his head but that was a brilliant ball. Archer tried jamming it towards point and missed it

The new stump is broken as well, Arshdeep Singh is creating expenses of the right kind for Punjab Kings. Wadhera charged before the ball was delivered, missed the slog, broke the stumps despite the slight deflection off the pad.

Middle stump broken! Came in with the angle, landed on a full length, Tilak looked to slog over midwicket. He missed it and the stump was broken one fourth of the way up. Arshdeep pumps the air, what commendable bowling under pressure!

Tilak premeditates and it costs him. He went on one knee and Arshdeep went into the pitch. Arshdeep looked to slog sweep, tried to rise with the bounce but couldn't. MI review for a wide but that's going over leg stump and is a fair ball
Low full toss outside off is driven to deep cover

Slot outside off, Tilak is on one knee and sweeps. Goes along the ground. Fielder runs across and fumbles, they take two. Replays show Liam ran and slid to the right from deep-mid, he palmed the ball past long-on, also running across and the ball went behind the latter. Just two nonetheless
Length outside off at 107kph, David looks to belt it. Doesn't middle it, goes to deep cover

Overthrow taken, Curran has a chat with the umpire and Tilak about something. The ball hit the stumps at the non-striker's end and Ellis tried running across to stop it. Might have had Tilak in the way. Was a full ball that was driven down the pitch
As low as full tosses get at 135kph. Flicked to deep midwicket
Slogged into space! Full toss at the top of the pad, David's front leg took a step in front and he whipped it 114 metres far. Over midwicket for a mighty six
Pulls the shortish ball to the right of deep midwicket, a slight fumble but the ball falls in front. Two taken
Full outside off, drills past the bowler. Long-on stops it but David will retain strike
Low full toss around off, flicked to deep midwicket

Flick finds mdwicket. Low full toss, SKY went across and whipped it across, hit with power but didn't manage to Taide around head-height. Sharp catch to end a 26-ball 57. Brilliant over after conceding the six off the first ball. SKY gets a standing ovation from his team-mates, Arshdeep is delighted with the catch.
Low full toss on off stump, driven to long-off. Two good balls in a row
Yorker outside off, David misses the cover drive and nods to acknowledge how good a ball that was
Full toss at 138kph is flicked. David was standing just outside off, his back leg was bent and the ball was on the top of the knee roll. Swiped and got full connection

Flickosaurus brings about an 87-metre six. SKY was charging, got a length ball and managed to help it along while adding power with a whip. Over backward square to bring the equation down to 40 off 18
Full on middle, driven to long-on
Goes across again, tries to pull fine but doesn't manage to do it as well. Deep backward square runs to the right, can't reach it before it bounces

SKY goes across, paddles, tumbles over and gets past fifty, his fastest in the IPL. He raises his bat in celebrations. That was a premeditated shot, he was well outside off, went low, got his head down and gave the ramp for the ball to bounce over
Length on top of middle and leg, flicked to long-on. Pace: 119kph
Yorker on off, driven to deep cover. Pace: 133kph
Length outside off, punched to long-on
Slower one on a length outside off, defended with an open bat face to point. SKY had gone across and was ready to shape to go big but adjusted to the lack of pace
Length just outside off at 118kph, clipped to long-on

Slower ball ends Green's 67, Curran takes the catch running to the right from cover. The back-of-hand ball at 111kph landed on a length outside off and was under stump height, Green heaved across and got a thick outside off. Ball went up, Curran went across and took it. He's pumped but Mumbai are still in the game and Green's innings has contributed to that
Wide and full, slashed along the ground. Gets it wide of long-off, fielder runs to the left and slides across but can't stop it. Green was on one knee and focused on powering it through, which he did
Full toss is punished, over long-on for a six. Just outside off at 132kph. Green wound up and swung for the fences with a straight-enough bat to get a 108-metre six
Makes room and belts the length ball to long-off
Down the track, manages to make room and slashes it wide of extra cover. Fielder runs to the right in the deep and dove but couldn't cut it across
Down the track, slogged over long-on to bring up a fifty. Green got to the pitch and deposited it 94 metres far
Driven to extra cover

Edge off the helicut goes through the vacant slip area. Length ball outside off, SKY tried to cut it after a wind-up but the 97kph ball spun away and took the edge. Luckily for the batter, it was in the gap
Full just down leg at 91kph, driven to long-on
Off drive on the move, way over the man in the deep. Pace was 124kph but it might as well have been 84 because SKY charged and extended the drive like he was playing a spinner
Makes room and slashes at the length ball, gets it off the bottom part of the bat. The 121kph ball goes to long-off
Length outside off, chopped behind point

Green had given up but the throw from cover by Chahar at the non-striker's end did not hit direct. Was a full ball outside off that was driven, the timing took the ball to the fielder faster than Green would have liked
Chopped to short third again, this time for a single
SKY gets on one knee and slaps the back of length slower ball outside off over short third. Not sure how he did it but it was like EA Cricket's cut shot
Full ball is clipped to deep midwicket

There's the SKY we know, catapult catapulls it fine for a 59-metre six. Got a short ball and went across, launched it with the bat going from down to up and front to back, (almost like when wearing a shawl) for a six
Low full toss is flicked to long-on. Simon Doull says on air that there's no dew so far
Bouncer. Green charges and swings off his balance almost as he twirls. The pull shot is beaten, ball goes just outside off and to the keeper
Hard length outside off at 121kph, driven to cover
Length at the pads, flicked to deep midwicket
Punches a length ball to long-on
Length outside off, cut to deep point
Low full toss on leg at 95kph is swept. Another one to the left of short fine for the third four in a row
Swept off the middle this time, goes to the left of short third this time. Full ball on the pads, hit hard and along the ground
Shoveled fine, short fine runs to the right and puts in the dive but can't stop it. Was a length ball angling in that was swept fine
Length ball follows the batters, flicked to long-on
Length outside off, cut to point
Length outside off, chopped to deep cover
Down the track, gets a length ball at 94kph. The bat face turned a bit but it goes safely to deep cover
Sweeps in the gap behind square. Was a full ball that raced along the ground
Length outside off, cut to point
Full just down leg, the 92kph ball is flicked to long-on
Makes room and gets yorker. Manages to squeeze it off the inside edge to square leg
Makes room and slaps the full ball to the left of long-off. Legbreak was overpitched, was hit into the ground
Length at the stumps at 93kph, driven to long-off

Spooned to the bowler's right and Livingstone takes a dolly. Legbreak lands around middle and turns away a bit, Rohit was trying to nudge it across but it popped up off the outside edge. The bowler ran across and took an easy catch
Misfield at long-on by Harpreet Brar. Went through the gap between his feet after he fumbled. Rohit was making room and was followed by a full ball that he flicked
Length outside off at 90kph, legbreak lands around off and spins away. Cut to deep cover
Goes across and paddles, gets it to the left of the keeper and fine to the boundary.
Works the length ball on leg at 99kph to square leg
Back of length outside off, punched to backward point
Launched downtown, was in the air for a while, cleared the advertising boards. The 85-metre six is Rohit's 250th in the IPL. He charged down the ground and drove, with a flowing follow-through
Makes room and slogs. It goes off the bottom, goes to long-on
Length ball is punched back to the bowler
Full on leg at 95kph, clipped to midwicket
Full outside off, drives through cover with a flurry. In the gap and the outfield is fast
Green makes room and slogs, the ball angles in and somehow misses leg stump. It landed on a length and came in too much
Makes room and drives the full ball. Lands on the edge of the circle and to long-off
Length outside off, cut into the grass. Goes to cover, throw at non-striker's end but the batter made it
Length just down leg, driven to to the right of point. Green takes off and is sent back
Length outside off, driven to long-off
Makes room and is followed by a yorker. Flicked to long-on
Full toss outside off driven to backward point
Length just on leg, clipped to midwicket
Full on middle, driven to long-off
Length ball pitches on leg and spun away. The 93kph ball is pulled into the ground with limited timing to midwicket
Full outside off, driven at cover
Full outside off, the back-of-the-hand slower ball has Rohit hit it off the bottom of the bat. Drove it to cover
Down the track, the wide yorker at 132kph is just inside the tramline. Left alone but that ain't a wide
Full around off, clipped to mid-on. Another quick single
Stays leg side and thumps it past the bowler. Full ball on middlle, Green thrashed it, went to the right of the pitch, went low and fast
Starts with a yorker to stop Rohit, charging, in his tracks. The 139kph ball goes off the bottom of the bat and goes towards mid-on
Full outside off, driven through cover and it sizzles the turf as it makes the fence

Scamper on and they get a single. Was a length ball in the channel, defended with an angled bat to Harpreet at short third. Went on the bounce at a good height. Left-handed throw at the striker's end doesn't yield a direct hit. Looked out had it hit, Green wasn't sliding his bat in
Monstrous pull punishes the slower ball with a pull for an 86-metre six over midwicket.
Full ball, Rohit looks to clip it and misses. Deflects off the pad to the leg side
Chipped off the bottom of the bat, balloons across and gets it to the right of mid-on. Was a full ball that was there for the drive, just that the timing wasn't there
Makes ample room and reaches out to the shortish ball. Slaps it off the toe end to cover
Wide down leg, tried to pull the back of lengther did Green and missed
Lap shot over fine leg, the ball boy catches it. Was a length ball outside off close to 140kph, Rohit was across, went on one knee and used the pace to redirect it fine. 58-metre six
Yorker outside off, Green tries jamming it across. Manages to squeeze it towards aquare leg

Edged and it goes in the vacant first-slip area. Green charged, Arshdeep went into the pitch over off. Green was standing on the leg-side tramline as he went for the slashing cut, edge went wide of the keeper.
Goes across and mistimes the pull, gets it across to deep backward square
Wide on a length at 140kph, reaches out and tries to launch it over cover. Misses

Green takes off, throw from short third at the non-striker's end doesn't connect! Was a cutter on a length just outside off, Rohit tried driving the ball straight. Got an inside edge and it went towards short third. Fielders converged and saw that Green couldn't apply the brakes and was halway down the pitch, the throw on the bounce went past the stumps. Would've been out by miles had it hit
Beaten on the sweep, lbw appeal is turned down. Was a length ball angling in, Rohit went for the fine sweep, may have gloved it onto pad. Went to short fine
Cover half-stops the ball with a leap to the right, mid-off stops it. Was a full ball outside off at 94kph
Drives a fullish ball outside off to cover
Connects this time, smacked over long-on for an 83-metre six. Strode towards the pitch of the slowish ball, heaved across and got it away
Bat-pads an attempted hoick over midwicket, lands on the off side of the pitch. Was a length ball angling into the body
Length just outside off, punched to cover
Length outside off, fiddles with the horizontal bat and misses
No deep third and Rohit capitalises. Gets a length ball at 137kph around sixth. Taps it on the head, races to the boundary
Length ball shapes back in to off, blocked towards cover
Back of length angling away outside off, goes under Rohit's attempted pull
Overpitched outside off at 136kph, Green lunged across and drove on the move to the left of mid-off
Short runs across from deep-backward point and takes a catch on the move at the cover boundary. Arshdeep has his 50th wicket.

Wide down leg. The full ball erred on the angle, went too straight, beat the flick - may have travelled fine and far had Kishan connected. Wide ball was full, Kishan tried to launch it square, lofted the square drive and Short started his long run, covered quite a few yards and took it sans fuss.
Down the track, turns the length ball into a full one, the 98kph ball is flicked over midwicket for a two-bounce four
Length ball down leg. Given wide, Punjab review. Rohit was standing in front of off and tried to clip it across. Missed the bat but tickled the pad onto the keeper. Decision reversed.
Rohit starts making room, Short darts it full down leg, Rohit bends his upper-body to the off side to let it go
Down the track, pushes it off a full length to mid-on
Beaten on the sweep, hit around the box, seemed to have gone down leg. Was a length ball that came in with the angle
Length on middle, punched back to the bowler
Full just outside off, flicked to long-on. Pace: 93kph
